verified_facts_for_writers.clean_core_5_dimensions: Extensibility, Data, Integration/Integrations, Processes, Operations. (SAP framing; hub 'complete guide' pakai 5 dimensi yang sama. SME verifikasi penamaan resmi terkini.)
verified_facts_for_writers.data_dimension_pillars: Governance, Strategy, Quality, Volume efficiency/Tiering (hot/warm/cold), Protection. Alat: SAP Information Lifecycle Management (ILM), Data Volume Management (DVM), archiving. (SME verifikasi.)
verified_facts_for_writers.extensibility_levels: Model Level A-D (2025) menggantikan model 3-tier lama. A = ABAP Cloud/SAP Build pakai released public API; B = classic API (BAPI/IDoc/RFC); C = objek internal/unreleased; D = modifikasi & implicit enhancement. (SME verifikasi definisi tiap level via SAP ICC/help.sap.com.)
verified_facts_for_writers.deployment_editions: Public Edition (GROW): clean core praktis DIPAKSA sistem, hanya key-user + developer + side-by-side extensibility, TANPA classic ABAP/modifikasi core. Private Edition (RISE) & on-premise: classic ABAP (Level C/D) masih mungkin tapi tidak disarankan, clean core = rekomendasi bukan paksaan. (SME verifikasi batasan per edisi terkini.)
verified_facts_for_writers.cloud_alm_kpis: Dashboard Clean Core Extensibility KPIs di RISE with SAP / SAP Cloud ALM: Technical Debt Score, Execution of Customer Objects, Business Modifications, Unused Customer Objects, Clean Core Share, Custom Code inventory (tren 3 bulan). Alat pendukung: ABAP Test Cockpit (ATC), SAP Readiness Check, SAP Custom Code Migration app. (SME verifikasi nama KPI + ketersediaan.)
verified_facts_for_writers.addons: SAP ICC (SAP Integration and Certification Center) menyertifikasi solusi partner mengikuti clean core (Level A-C). Add-on ABAP Cloud native untuk Public Edition upgrade-safe + fulfilment via SAP Store. On-stack vs side-by-side (BTP) add-on. (SME verifikasi program sertifikasi + istilah 'SAP Certified' terkini.)
verified_facts_for_writers.governance: Governance 'with teeth': tiap request kustomisasi lewat review formal 3 pertanyaan (bisa via konfigurasi standar? bisa via ekstensi BTP? benar-benar wajib?). Guardrail teknis: ABAP Cloud (hanya released API) sebagai model dev baru; custom-code register; approval workflow; quality gate. Prinsip 'get clean, stay clean'. (SME verifikasi.)
verified_facts_for_writers.ecc_deadline: SAP ECC mainstream maintenance berakhir 2027, extended maintenance 2030. (SME konfirmasi ke SAP official — pernah bergeser historis.)
verified_facts_for_writers.soltius_framing: Soltius = SAP Platinum Partner via United VARs, Metrodata Group sejak 1998. Implements/migrates/supports SAP - NEVER builds. Anchor: Implementation + Enhancement + ERP Strategy + AMS pasca go-live. Max 2-3 self-mentions.
